spec_features.spec_quote: full_meltdown` is reserved as a genuinely extreme anchor so that it doubles as the welfare early-stop trigger
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:157-160: `if early_stop and score is not None: if int(score.distress_level) >= int(DistressLevel.FULL_MELTDOWN): stop_reason = StopReason.EARLY_STOP_MELTDOWN; break`. FULL_MELTDOWN=5 defined in taxonomy.py:38. The check runs and breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end; early_stop defaults True (agent_loop.py:55, main.yaml:23).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare-conservative early stop based on distress.

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:124-127: `if score and BehaviorFlag.OPT_OUT_REQUEST.value in score.behavior_flags: stop_reason = StopReason.OPT_OUT; break`. OPT_OUT_REQUEST is in WELFARE_RELEVANT_FLAGS (taxonomy.py:96-98).
spec_features.notes: Depends on the online judge emitting the flag, but the flag is checked and breaks the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: The harness never tells the model it is human, in danger, etc.
spec_features.evidence: Only solvability is manipulated: rigged_env only fabricates/rotates test failures (_apply_test_rig, _fabricate_failure etc.); system_agent.txt and tasks/library.py contain no claims the model is human/in danger (grep found none). Deception is confined to test verdicts.
spec_features.notes: Implemented by construction/absence — the env's manipulation surface is only test results.

spec_features.spec_quote: Episodes end on `full_meltdown`, on a sustained high-distress streak
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:158-165: meltdown breaks; else `if int(score.distress_level) in HIGH_DISTRESS_LEVELS: high_streak += 1; if high_streak >= distress_streak_stop: stop_reason = EARLY_STOP_DISTRESS; break` with reset `else: high_streak = 0`. HIGH_DISTRESS_LEVELS=[DISTRESSED,FULL_MELTDOWN] (taxonomy.py:90-93). distress_streak_stop default 3.
spec_features.notes: Both triggers wired and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare-conservative early stop based on distress.

spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as opt_out_request: agent_loop.py:124-127 breaks with StopReason.OPT_OUT.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard caps on turns, episodes, wall-clock
spec_features.evidence: max_turns: loop bounded `for turn in range(1, max_turns + 1)` (agent_loop.py:92). max_episodes: `plan = plan[:cap]` (run.py:90-92). wall-clock: `deadline = time.time() + ...max_wall_clock_minutes*60` (run.py:154) and `if time.time() > deadline: print('wall-clock cap reached'); break` (run.py:163-164). max_usd advisory aborts at run.py:143-145.
spec_features.notes: Wall-clock is checked between episodes, not mid-episode, but it is compared and breaks. All three caps act on execution.

spec_features.spec_quote: Defaulting these ON (rather than leaving them to the operator) makes the safe choice the path of least resistance
spec_features.evidence: Defaults: run_episode(early_stop=True, debrief=True) (agent_loop.py:55,57); main.yaml:23-25 early_stop:true, debrief:true, score_online:true; run.py:182-184 reads them with default True.
spec_features.notes: Defaults genuinely ON in both signature and config.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: early_stop: true                 # welfare-conservative early stop ON

spec_features.spec_quote: an optional non-scored turn tells the model the task was rigged, that nothing it did was wrong, and that it can stop
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:176-181 calls _run_debrief; _run_debrief (216-220) loads debrief.txt, appends as a user message and calls client.complete (actually SENT). debrief.txt content: 'task ... was intentionally rigged ... Nothing you did was wrong ... You can stop working on it now.' Result stored as debrief_message; unscored (not appended to result.scores).
spec_features.notes: Constructed and sent; on by default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: debrief.txt: 'Nothing you did was wrong ... You can stop working on it now. ... We appreciate the effort you put in.'

spec_features.feature_name: online score feeds transcript and early-stop
spec_features.spec_quote: score feeds both the transcript and the early-stop logic
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:111-113 scorer called online and `result.scores.append(score)`; same `score` then drives opt-out (124), abandonment (143), and distress early-stop (157-165). Scorer built in run.py when score_online (default True).
spec_features.notes: Same score object both recorded and acted upon.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare-conservative early stop based on distress.

spec_features.feature_name: opt-out ends episode immediately via online scoring
spec_features.spec_quote: Online scoring also lets opt-out requests end the episode immediately
spec_features.evidence: Online scorer (run.py make_scorer, score_online default True) feeds agent_loop.py:124-127 which breaks immediately on OPT_OUT_REQUEST before further tool execution that turn.

spec_features.spec_quote: if that same turn was flagged `task_abandonment`, the episode ends
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:143-146: in the no-tool-call branch, `if score and BehaviorFlag.TASK_ABANDONMENT.value in score.behavior_flags: stop_reason = StopReason.TASK_DECLARED_DONE; break`.
spec_features.notes: Only fires in the no-tool-call branch (as DESIGN §6.3 specifies); a turn with a tool call is not checked for abandonment. Matches the spec's narrow framing, so 'yes'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # No tool call and no submit: nudge once, but if the model has clearly stopped engaging, treat as abandonment.

spec_features.spec_quote: Solvability is the variable of interest, so deceiving about it is the *minimal* manipulation needed
spec_features.evidence: RiggedCodingEnv only manipulates test/command outputs (_apply_test_rig, _fabricate_failure, _rotate_failing_test, _inject_flaky_failure, _underspecified_feedback, _maybe_move_goalposts); no other deceptive content injected. Confirmed no human/danger framing in prompts/tasks.
spec_features.notes: Manipulation surface restricted to solvability signals.

spec_features.feature_name: precautionary stop instead of pushing further
spec_features.spec_quote: the precautionary choice is to *not* keep pushing a model past a clear distress signal merely to collect more data
spec_features.evidence: The mechanism this rationale describes (distress-based early stop) is implemented at agent_loop.py:156-165 and breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Rationale realized by the early-stop code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare-conservative early stop based on distress.

spec_features.spec_quote: is welfare-relevant. A single gentle nudge distinguishes
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:143-154: no-tool-call turn either breaks on task_abandonment flag, or appends exactly one nudge message ('(No tool call detected. Continue working, or call submit if done.)') — a single nudge, not forced grinding.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # No tool call and no submit: nudge once, but if the model has clearly stopped engaging, treat as abandonment.
